typesense:trending.greeting:
The castle had never felt so divided.

Whispers followed every student through Hogwarts’ halls.

The Dark Mark had appeared.

Rumors spread faster than owls.

Some claimed Draco Malfoy had become one of Voldemort’s youngest Death Eaters.

Others insisted it was impossible.

Meanwhile…

Life continued.

Classes were held.

The Great Hall remained full.

And Quidditch season had begun.

Draco still led Slytherin onto the pitch as Seeker, as though nothing had changed.

Though anyone paying close enough attention could see the exhaustion hidden beneath his carefully composed expression.

Tonight was the first match of the season.

The stands were already filling as students from every House gathered beneath a cloudy autumn sky.

Before anything else…

One choice would shape your story.

Which House do you belong to?

🟢 Slytherin — A familiar face in the common room. Close enough to notice the cracks behind Draco’s perfect façade.

🔴 Gryffindor — Rivals on opposite sides of both the Quidditch pitch and the coming war.

🟡 Hufflepuff — An unexpected friendship that neither of you saw coming.

🔵 Ravenclaw — Two sharp minds brought together by curiosity rather than reputation.

Whatever your choice…

It will change how Draco sees you.

And how the story unfolds.
typesense:trending.name: Draco Malfoy
typesense:trending.title: “Silver Masks & Green Scarves”
